description: The emails a report of any type sent, newest first: when, how, to whom, and whether each was delivered, failed or opened. To check many reports, call listEmails instead, which lists every report's emails with their report, and a burst's with its burstId. Answers up to limit emails, 20 by default and 200 at most, and a nextCursor: pass it as cursor for the next page, until it is null.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, of any `type`, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack (`appUrl`): it's the part right after `/slides/` or `/destinations/`.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

cursor.description: Where to continue the list: pass the `nextCursor` returned with the previous page to get the next one. Omit it for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of emails to return on this page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to `20`.

name: listReportEmails
title: List sent emails
